{{Quote|Now I'm not exactly a gambling man, but if someone were to tell me a disorganized species with industrial level technology was going up against an Imperial base, I'd say the smart money would be on the Imps. That is, I would have said that until I saw those Dressellians fight with my own eyes. Now I'm not so sure.|Pyrron Nox describes the exploits of Orrimaarko and his comrades|<ref name="gg12" />}}
'''Orrimaarko''', known to many as simply '''Prune Face''', was the [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of [[Sreeharlo]] and eventually a resistance fighter and key figure in the liberation of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Dressel/Legends|Dressel]]. He was [[Speciesism|xenophobic]], particularly toward [[Human/Legends|Humans]], and when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] subjugated Dressel around [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]], he and his fellows took up arms and fought back, becoming masters of guerrilla tactics. Aided by their allies, the more technologically sophisticated [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], who provided them with advanced weaponry and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] training, a Dressellian rebellion was formed with Orrimaarko at its helm, effectively fending off the Empire. They became embroiled in a war lasting over a decade, which mostly occurred at small engagements in the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] dense [[Forest/Legends|forests]].

When the Bothans allied with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], an invitation to the Alliance was issued to Orrimaarko and his people, which they reluctantly accepted. Orrimaarko became the first Dressellian to take command of an [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] team; however, he and his colleagues were often mocked and ridiculed behind their backs by the predominantly Human Alliance, which he viewed with much concern. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Orrimaarko served at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. One [[Standard year/Legends|year]] later, in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Rebels conducted a strike against the Empire's [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], with a [[Endor strike team/Legends|strike team]] disabling the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon's]] [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield]] on Endor's surface. Based on his experience, Orrimaarko felt that he should have been selected to lead the mission, but instead, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], a man whom Orrimaarko felt was far less qualified, was chosen and made a general. Orrimaarko went to Endor as part of Solo's team and played an invaluable role in the Alliance's victory at the pivotal [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], but he was quick to berate Alliance officials for what he saw as [[Humanocentrism]] and favoritism. With their homeworld eventually purged of any Imperial presence, the Dressellians returned to their reclusive, xenophobic ways despite becoming a member state of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Biography==
===Resistance leader===
{{Quote|Prune Face introduces himself as Orrimaarko, leader of a resistance cell on Dressel.|Pyrron Nox|<ref name="gg12" />}}
Orrimaarko was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]<ref name="ccg">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Orrimaarko}}</ref> [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]] born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dressel/Legends|Dressel]] during the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="gg12" /> At some point, he had become the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of [[Sreeharlo]] on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="Stay on Target">[[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']]</ref> Around [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]], shortly after Orrimaarko's [[Species/Legends|species]] had reached industrial-level technology, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] arrived in the [[Dressel system/Legends|Dressel system]] and subjugated a number of planets, including Dressel and a world settled by the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], who had first introduced the Dressellians to [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] society. The Empire tried to quell the Dressellians by force, but the species<ref name="gg12" />&mdash;[[Speciesism|xenophobic]], freedom-loving,<ref name="egtas">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> and tenacious&mdash;refused, wanting to live by their own terms. Numerous resistance forces were established, with small numbers in each group and a single leader.<ref name="gg12" /> Orrimaarko, who had by then left his position as Sreeharlo's governor, attained the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[General/Legends|general]] and<ref name="Stay on Target" /> became the leader of one of the more prominent resistance forces.<ref name="gg12" /> Assisting him were Generals [[Panno]] and [[Neeralli]], the latter being Orrimaarko's cavalry [[Commander/Legends|commander]].<ref name="Stay on Target" /> The groups fled into the [[Forest/Legends|forests]] and hills and became masters of guerrilla tactics, using their inferior [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]] and [[black-powder]] against the might of the state-of-the-art Imperial forces.<ref name="gg12" /> To assist Orrimaarko's efforts and to invade Imperial reprisals, many Dressellians reverted to more traditional lifestyles.<ref name="Stay on Target" />

[[File:Orrimaarko-Masterwork2018.png|left|thumb|Orrimaarko]]
As noted resistance leader<ref name="swe">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> during the battle with the Empire, which lasted over a decade,<ref name="gg12" /> he became the leader of the entire Dressellian species.<ref name="ccg" /> Over time, the Bothans began to surreptitiously help the Dressellians in their endeavors, providing them with more sophisticated, energy-based weapons, but few of these shipments made it past the Imperials in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]].<ref name="egtas" /> The Dressellians were undeterred, however, as their tenacity and fierceness made up for what their technology lacked. Orrimaarko wore an eye patch, and was frequently referred to as "Prune Face."<ref name="gg12" />

During the early stages of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], Orrimaarko and his fellow rebels, striking from the thick forests of his homeworld, planned to raid an Imperial base. While they stealthily approached the base, Orrimaarko encountered a [[Human/Legends|Human]], [[Pyrron Nox]], and believing him to be an enemy, attacked the man. After hitting him over the head with his slugthrower, the Dressellian put a [[Knife/Legends|knife]] to his [[Throat/Legends|throat]], and made demands to him in [[Dressellese|his native tongue]]. The only word the two had mutual understanding of was "Human;" Orrimaarko hated that species because of the Empire's [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]] beliefs. Before he could cut Nox, a [[Storm Skimmer Patrol Sled]] arrived and shined a light at the two [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]], ordering them to be still. Pulling out his miniature, double-barreled weapon, Orrimaarko felled the two [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] the Storm Skimmer with precise shots. Almost immediately, an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]] began to bear down on the two. The quick-thinking Orrimaarko ran to the downed Storm Skimmer and, using a piece of rope, tied up the controls. He then sped the [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] toward the AT-ST, grabbing Nox and hiding behind a tree before the two vehicles collided and exploded. Another intruder, [[Morst Tayl'skar]], then came upon Orrimaarko and Nox, explaining in Dressellian that he and the Human were both [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] bringing arms onto the planet. Orrimaarko calmed down and ceased being aggressive to Nox. The two smugglers accompanied Orrimaarko's men during the attack on the Imperial base; Nox was skeptical of their chances against such a heavily fortified target, but the Dressellians fought as they always did, and triumphed.<ref name="gg12" />

===Joining the Alliance===
{{Quote|But when it came to choosing the leader for the shuttle team, I felt I was the best candidate because of my espionage experience. Instead, Han Solo, a man who barely graduated the Imperial Academy, was elevated to the level of general and given command. I submit to you that I would have had the shield down faster and more efficiently. I only hope that in the future the best person for the job is chosen based on skill rather than what is most popular or convenient.|Orrimaarko, to Crix Madine, in the aftermath of the victory at Endor|<ref name="egtas" />}}
[[File:Orrimaarko_databank.jpg|thumb|right|210px|Orrimaarko attends the Rebel briefing at Sullust.]]
As the war progressed on and away from Dressel, the Bothans became more and more involved with the Dressellian people's struggle against the Empire.<ref name="gg12" /> After the Bothans threw their lot in with the Rebel Alliance, [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] invited the Dressellians to join as well,<ref name="db">{{DB|character|orrimaarko|Orrimaarko}}</ref> some time before [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="rebellion">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref> through their Bothan contacts.<ref name="ccg" /> They accepted, though were wary of the fact that the upper echelons of the Alliance was made up almost exclusively of Humans.<ref name="egtas" /> Orrimaarko became a prominent [[Spy/Legends|espionage]] and guerrilla warfare expert in the Alliance, and was the first of many Dressellians to be given command of an [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] team.<ref name="swe" /> Despite this honor, he found that he was frequently ridiculed behind his back by other members of the Alliance, particularly Humans.<ref name="egtas" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Orrimaarko served under [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin's]] command in [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], the headquarters of [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. That year, the Empire attacked the base during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], which forced the Alliance off the planet.<ref name="Galactic Files">{{Topps|set=2013 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Series 2|cardname=Orrimaarko (Rebel Briefing)}}</ref><ref name="mts">''[[The Movie Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>

===Strike on Endor===
After building up a reputation as an important leader in the Alliance for some time, Orrimaarko,<ref name="egtas" /> who had been stationed with the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] since his evacuation from Hoth,<ref name="Galactic Files" /><ref name="mts" /> was invited, along with a contingent of Dressellians, to a briefing of some of the Alliance's foremost leaders aboard [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']], in the [[Sullust system/Legends|Sullust system]].<ref name="egtas" /> Ackbar, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]], and Alliance [[Commander-in-Chief/Legends|Commander-in-Chief]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] briefed the attendants in preparation for a decisive strike on the Empire.<ref name="rotj" /> However, while Orrimaarko was enthusiastic about the impending mission, he was disheartened by the lack of [[Non-huMan|non-Humans]] present;<ref name="egtas" /> aside from [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], Ackbar's [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] staff, a number of [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] and a sole [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]], those assembled were all Humans. Mon Mothma then arrived, informing the congregation that [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan spies]] working for the Rebellion had discovered a [[Death Star II/Legends|second Imperial Death Star]] under construction at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star's]] weapons were not yet fully operational, and the Bothans had learned that [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] would be aboard the [[Battle station/Legends|station]] overseeing the final construction efforts in person. Before any attack could be made on the station itself, though, its [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield]] had to be deactivated from Endor's surface.<ref name="rotj" /> Because of his experience working against the Empire in similar terrain,<ref name="gg12" /> Orrimaarko felt that he was the ideal candidate to lead the [[Endor strike team/Legends|strike team]],<ref name="egtas" /> made up exclusively of volunteers who were stationed at Hoth the previous year.<ref name="mts" />

However, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was selected ahead of him. Orrimaarko was disgusted that Solo, a man who had been dishonorably discharged from Imperial service and who made his living through smuggling, was chosen instead of one as experienced as himself. Despite his anger and contempt toward Solo,<ref name="egtas" /> Orrimaarko followed him into battle on the surface,<ref name="Galactic Files" /> serving as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] and leader during the pivotal [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="egtas" />

After landing on Endor, the strike team began scouting the area, but Solo, along with strike team members [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] became separated from the main group, with Solo ordering the strike team to continue on.<ref name="rotj" /> The squad made its way toward the shield generator under Derlin's lead. Although they successfully avoided several Imperial patrols, the team's [[Medic/Legends|medic]], [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Delevar]], almost compromised their position by preparing to take a potshot at a [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bike]], to which he was stopped and reprimanded by Derlin.<ref name="Night Attack">{{WEGCite|story=Night Attack|book=Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi|reprint=1}}</ref>

When night fell,<ref name="Night Attack" /> Orrimaarko<ref name="Galactic Files" /> and the rest of the squad made camp in a camouflaged shallow ravine, having two sentries posted and setting up a [[blanket grid]] with their scanning equipment. Shortly following their first [[Sleep/Legends|sleeping]] shift, the scanners detected an All Terrain Scout Transport [[Walker/Legends|walker]] moving toward their location. Corporal Dansra Beezer jammed its transmissions when it became clear the walker would not pass them by. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Greeve (Human)|Greeve]] used<ref name="Night Attack" /> his [[A280 blaster rifle/Legends|A280 blaster rifle]],<ref name="Endor-A280">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=A280 Sharpshooter Rifle}}</ref> to destroy both spotlights, and the squad circled the walker in order to keep it off balance. Delevar fired a [[Smoke canister/Legends|smoke canister]] into the AT-ST's [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] window when it began firing randomly into the trees and foliage. The resulting smoke explosion forced the walker pilots to abandon the vehicle and surrender to the strike team. The squad captured the pilots and forced them to make a comm check-in at [[Blaster/Legends|blasterpoint]]. The squad continued on to the rendezvous point, forcing the walker pilot to make several more check-ins on the way to explain the scout walker's absence.<ref name="Night Attack" />

[[File:Ds2destroyed.png|thumb|left|250px|The strike team's destruction of the deflector shield enables Rebel starfighters to destroy the second Death Star itself.]]
Solo and the others then rejoined the rest of the strike team, having allied themselves with the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] tribe of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], which showed the Rebel commandos a route to the [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator bunker's]] backdoor.<ref name="rotj" /> Orrimaarko<ref name="Galactic Files" /> and the rest of the commandos proceeded into the bunker; however, they were soon ambushed by [[Tempest Force/Legends|Tempest Force]], the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] [[Legion/Legends|legion]] stationed on the moon, and the entire strike team was captured and led outside the bunker. Their capture proved to be brief, however, as the Ewoks attacked the Imperial [[Troop/Legends|troops]], turning the tide of the battle in favor of the Rebel Alliance. The Rebel commandos successfully destroyed the shield generator<ref name="rotj" /> with the use of [[7-PrG proton grenade/Legends|7-PrG proton grenades]].<ref name="EG">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> With the Death Star's [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] destroyed, Alliance [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] were able to enter the Imperial [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] and fire at its [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|main reactor]], setting off a chain reaction of explosions that ultimately destroyed the [[Space station/Legends|station]].<ref name="rotj" />

Shortly after the battle, which paved the way for the formation of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Orrimaarko informed Crix Madine of his issues with Solo in a transmission. He told the Alliance leader that he sometimes felt as if the people he worked alongside in the Alliance were as prejudiced against [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] as the Empire was, and he noted the few non-Human commanders serving at Endor. He also put it to Madine that he would have been quicker and more efficient than Solo in taking down the shield generator, and that he hoped in the future people were appointed to positions based on merit rather than any other factor, be it popularity or speciesism.<ref name="egtas" /> Ultimately, the Battle of Endor marked the dawn of a new era. For their part in assisting the Alliance, the Dressellians were granted membership to the New Republic; however, they rarely attended meetings and mostly kept to themselves, until their homeworld was once again subjugated during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="negas">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|This wrinkly-headed guy with an eye patch barrels me over, and holds a knife to my throat. He's got this crazed look in his one good eye, whispering "Human" with such hatred that I began to rethink the whole smuggling business and consider a job in accounting.|Pyrron Nox|<ref name="gg12" />}}
Orrimaarko was a confident individual. He had great faith in his own abilities as a leader and [[Commando/Legends|commando]], believing himself to be one of the best such soldiers in the Alliance.<ref name="egtas" /> While he was at Echo Base, Han Solo saw Orrimaarko's loyalty and dedication in action, as well as willingness to get the job done,<ref name="Galactic Files" /><ref name="mts" /> and was aware of his resourcefulness and ability to devise creative situations.<ref name="Galactic Files" /><ref name="reberasource">''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]''</ref> Upon joining the strike team, Orrimaarko eagerly volunteered in order to get revenge on the Empire, having been turned into a hardened veteran from the Battle of Hoth. Solo informed the strike team about the risks of the mission, and Orrimaarko willingly and eagerly accepted them.<ref name="Galactic Files" /><ref name="mts" /> During the battle, he felt that he could have had the Death Star's shield down with more speed and efficiency than Han Solo, despite the fact that Solo's mission was considered a great success and he was hailed as a hero. Orrimaarko was also stubborn in this regard, refusing to accept the Alliance's decision without complaining even after the battle had concluded.<ref name="egtas" />

[[File:Pruneface-SWR.png|thumb|right|Orrimaarko during the Galactic Civil War.]]
He was also an able leader, having been first given command of one of the rebel cells on Dressel, then leadership of the entire resistance force, and eventually command of an Alliance SpecForces team. Additionally, he was a fierce and capable fighter.<ref name="egtas" /> While many species who attempted to disrupt the Empire's operations on their respective homeworlds were subjugated with ease, the Dressellians lasted over a dozen years and ultimately drove the Imperials off-world due to their tenacity in battle. Orrimaarko was no exception, and he fought without fear or remorse for the damage inflicted on the enemy. He worked well in small groups but even alone was considered a force to be reckoned with. As witnessed by smuggler Pyrron Nox, the Dressellian rebel accurately dispatched two Imperial scout troopers with his slugthrower, before resourcefully using their vehicle to down an AT-ST, a feat few beings in the galaxy could attest to. He had no qualms about shooting first and asking questions later, and nearly killed the innocent Nox in the forest.<ref name="gg12" />

Orrimaarko shared a trait with most of his fellow Dressellians in xenophobia. Aside from the Bothans, the Dressellian people weren't in contact with any other species, and preferred it that way; they liked to keep to themselves and valued their freedom. Thus, they resented the Human race, of which the Imperial forces they faced in combat were comprised, and believed the Humans in the Alliance little better than their Imperial counterparts.<ref name="egtas" /> Orrimaarko stood at 1.8 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] and weighed 80 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]],<ref name="H2H" /> and had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and light brown skin. He wore a patch over his left eye.<ref name="rotj" />

==Equipment==
Orrimaarko was armed with a [[Dressellian Projectile Rifle]],<ref name="toy">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (toy line)|pack=Prune Face|link=VINtPruneface.asp}}</ref> along with a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] and [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]].<ref name="H2H" /> He was also equipped with a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]].<ref name="Vintage Collection">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Vintage Collection|pack=#114: Orrimaarko (Prune Face)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/Orrimaarko_Prune_Face_Vintage_Collection_TVC_VC114.asp}}</ref> As a part of the Endor strike team, Orrimaarko was equipped with basic commando gear, which included a standard [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], a low-feedback scanner, a [[Sensor scrambler (equipment)|sensor scrambler]], a [[Sound suppressor|heavily muffled]] blaster, and full-forest-camouflage [[Alliance military uniform/Legends|fatigues]].<ref name="GG5">[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi'', Second Edition]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I'm sorry, who the hell are you? ''"<br />"''Prune Face, ma'am. ''"<br />"''Anyway, the Emperor has made a—''"<br />"''When the face is a prune, then action goes boom!|Mon Mothma and “Prune Face”| <ref name="Robot Chicken">''[[Robot Chicken: Star Wars Episode III]]''</ref>}}
[[File:PruneFacePolaroid-MOROTJ.png|thumb|250px|right|A Polaroid taken as costume reference for filming "scene 132" of ''Return of the Jedi''.]]
The wrinkled character who eventually became Orrimaarko was created for the film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], originally released in [[1983]]. A number of these beings appear in the Endor briefing scenes, among the few alien Rebels depicted in the films. Later, [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] produced an action figure of one and named him "Prune Face." Some fans speculated that the Prune Faces were in fact the Bothans mentioned by Mon Mothma in ''Return of the Jedi'', but the release of [[Timothy Zahn]]'s ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'' in [[1991]] dispelled that theory, revealing the Bothans to be a furred species, completely unlike the "Prune Face" and his comrades.<ref name="db" /> Later, the [[1995]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]], established the Prune Faces as Dressellians, and named the Kenner-produced character "Orrimaarko." His name is a [[Tuckerization|tuckerism]] of [[Orrin Marko]], a friend of Pablo Hidalgo.<ref name="blog">{{Blog|pablog|88|Origin of the Rookies}}</ref> With the release of ''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]'' on [[October 1]], [[2013]], it was revealed that the name "Prune Face" was not first assigned to the character by Kenner. It was written on a character reference Polaroid photo taken for "scene 132" during filming of ''Return of the Jedi''.<ref name="MOROTJ">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>

Orrimaarko has appeared in a number of ''[[Star Wars]]'' works since, including [[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']] and the ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', which recap and expand upon the information established about the character in ''Galaxy Guide 12''. He also appears in the game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']].

In ''[[Robot Chicken: Star Wars Episode III]]'', Orrimaarko appears, referred to as Prune Face (as he was in his original release in the Kenner toyline) who exaggerates his career into a more action-filled life, when he's actually only been hired by the Rebellion to fix a copy machine. The sketch ends with a card reading "Prune Face got an action figure anyway".
